sources.name: Planning Data API docs
sources.fact: single interface covers planning constraints and housing datasets; query semantics must be kept distinct from policy conclusions

sources.name: LBBD Inclusive Growth infrastructure and transport
sources.fact: IDP assesses current infrastructure and future requirements; transport strategy supports housing-growth planning

examples: Adopted 2037 Local Plan takes precedence over Regulation 19 draft context
Required housing 38864 is plan-level requirement, not parcel capacity
London Riverside 44000-home/29000-job potential is strategic OA evidence
Barking Riverside 2026 consent 20000 homes is site-level consent context, not parcel-specific score
Local Development Scheme is timetable/process evidence, not development permission
Infrastructure Delivery Plan identifies needs but does not prove delivery at a parcel
Planning Data local-plan dataset origin caveat must be retained where data is MHCLG-created
Infrastructure-funding-statement dataset provider coverage is partial and cannot support a blanket negative result
